title: RBH17 6-round AES / aes-6r-yoyo-rbh2017

target.description: 6 nonlinear AES rounds in the source enck/deck convention, omitting initial ShiftRows and final ShiftRows/MixColumns. Section 3 explains public linear conjugation to full-round AES.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key and its expanded round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: Yoyo swap-generated adaptive encryption/decryption texts under one unknown key; the source native chosen-text count is not automatically an aggregate oracle-call count.
setting.reference_model: Adaptive bidirectional secret-key distinguishing versus a random permutation and its inverse; no known-key or related-key oracle.

time.note: Table 2 offline XOR count; encryption/decryption oracle executions are not included.

data.note: Section 3.4 D(t)=p_w(t)^-1 p_w(4-t)^-1; p_w(t)=binom(4,t)*2^(-32t), t=2. Source rounds to 2^122.83.
